voice.spoken.tail: The details are in the chat.
voice.notes.synthesisFailed: Couldn't create the voice reply ({reason}), so this one is text only.
voice.notes.synthesisPartial: Only the first part of the voice reply was created ({reason}). The full text is shown as usual.
voice.notes.toolVoicePartial: Only the first part of this voice message was sent ({reason}).
voice.notes.relayPartial:
Only the first part of this voice message was sent ({reason}). {names} didn't get to say this, so here's the text:
{text}
voice.reason.segmentFormatMismatch: The speech service returned segments in different formats, so they couldn't be joined
voice.reason.notWav: The speech service didn't return a playable WAV
voice.skipped.turnNotCompleted: This turn didn't finish its reply ({outcome})
voice.skipped.lastInputNotVoice: The last thing you said this turn wasn't a voice message
voice.skipped.nothingToSay: Nothing to read aloud this turn
voice.skipped.restarted: The daemon restarted before this turn finished its reply
voice.missingReference.title: Import a reference voice to get voice replies
voice.missingReference.body: An agent wanted to talk to you by voice (you sent a voice message, or it wanted to send one), but no reference voice has been imported yet, so it replied in text. Go to Settings › Voice and import a clean voice recording (common audio formats work, 1–30 s; the transcript is recognized automatically); replies will use that voice from then on. This item archives itself once you import one.
voice.warmup.queued: Waiting for the speech recognition model
voice.warmup.needsReference: No reference voice yet. Import one, then warm up.
voice.warmup.busy: The speech service is busy (the GPU is in use by something else). Trying again shortly.
voice.debug.noReference: No reference voice yet. Import one in Settings › Voice first.
voice.recognizer.hint: Check that voice.recognizer.python in the data folder's config points to a Python with faster-whisper installed, and that the model (large-v3 by default, small as the fallback) is in the local Hugging Face cache.
voice.recognizer.lsmHint: First check whether the ergo-asr service is running in the service manager (the service manager restarts it if it dies, and the model then takes 45–60 s to load again), then make sure voice.recognizer.url in the data folder's config (default http://127.0.0.1:8091) points at the same address.
voice.recognizer.idle: The speech recognition process exited after being idle
voice.recognizer.noProgram: No program is configured for speech recognition
voice.recognizer.loadTimeout: Loading the model took more than {seconds} s without finishing
voice.recognizer.exitedSignal: The recognition process exited (exit code {code}, signal {signal})
voice.recognizer.jobAssignFailed: Couldn't put the recognition process into a Job object: {error}
voice.recognizer.timeout: Recognition took more than {seconds} s without a result
voice.recognizer.noAnswer: The recognizer process didn't answer within {seconds} s
voice.recognizer.lsmOff: Can't reach the speech recognition service ({url}): {error}
voice.recognizer.lsmStatus: The speech recognition service returned HTTP {status} ({url})
voice.recognizer.lsmNoAnswer: The speech recognition service didn't answer within {seconds} s ({url})
voice.recognizer.lsmNotLoaded: The speech recognition service hasn't loaded its model yet ({url})
voice.recognizer.lsmBadReply: The speech recognition service returned an unrecognised reply
voice.recognizer.audiocppHint: Open Settings · Components and check that audio.cpp is running and the speech recognition model is installed. For a service you set up yourself, check that it has a speech recognition model with the id asr and that its address is voice.speech.url in the config.
voice.recognizer.audiocppNoModel: The speech service ({url}) has no speech recognition model (id {model})
voice.recognizer.audiocppLoadFailed: The speech service can't use the speech recognition model: {reason}
voice.recognizer.audiocppBusy: The speech service is busy ({url}); try again shortly
voice.recognizer.audiocppRejected: The speech service won't take this recording: {reason}
voice.recognizer.audiocppNotWav: This recording isn't a WAV, and the speech service only takes WAV
voice.recognizer.audiocppNoFfmpeg: This recording isn't a WAV and the speech service only takes WAV, but there is no ffmpeg on this computer to convert it. New recordings are converted by the page first; to recognize this one, put ffmpeg on the PATH and tap retry
voice.speech.modelHint: Replace it with the Fish-Audio S2 Pro model id on the audio.cpp server (usually "tts")
voice.speech.placeholderModel: voice.speech.model in the data folder's config is still the example placeholder. {hint}
voice.speech.nonAsciiPath: The recording path of reference voice {id} has non-ASCII characters, which audio.cpp can't read. Move the data folder to an ASCII-only path.
voice.speech.failed: The speech service returned an error ({reason})
voice.speech.healthTimeout: The speech service didn't respond within {seconds} s ({url})
voice.reference.badName: A name is required, up to {max} characters
voice.reference.badText: The transcript can be up to {max} characters (leave it out and it's transcribed automatically)
voice.reference.tooBig: The reference recording is too large (max {max} MB)
voice.reference.tooShort: The reference recording is too short: at least {min} s (5–15 s of clean speech recommended)
voice.reference.tooLong: The reference recording is too long: at most {max} s (5–15 s of clean speech recommended)
voice.reference.noFfmpeg: ffmpeg isn't installed on this computer, so the recording can't be converted to WAV. Install it first (even WAV files are converted through it).
voice.reference.convertFailed: This recording can't be converted to WAV (unrecognized audio format or a damaged file): {reason}
voice.reference.convertTimeout: Converting the recording to WAV timed out (waited {seconds} s)
voice.reference.convertedBad: The converted recording isn't a 16 kHz mono PCM WAV, so it can't be used
voice.reference.emptyText: No words were transcribed from this recording. Try a clearer recording with someone speaking.
voice.reference.transcribeUnavailable: Speech recognition isn't available right now, so the transcript can't be generated: {reason}
voice.reference.noRecognizer: No recognizer is available to generate the transcript automatically
voice.intake.missing: Recording not found: media {mediaId} isn't stored (upload and finish it before sending)
voice.intake.notAudio: This recording isn't in a recognized audio format (webm, ogg, mp4, wav…) and can't be sent as a voice message
voice.recognize.mediaGone: The recording is no longer in the media library
voice.recognize.onlyFiller: Only the model's own filler phrases (like "please like and subscribe") were recognized, so they were discarded
voice.unavailableNotice.title: Speech recognition unavailable
voice.unavailableNotice.body: Voice messages are still received, but can't be transcribed (marked as failed): {reason}. {hint}Once fixed, choose "Recognize again" in the voice bubble's menu.
voice.retry.keyReused: This idempotency key was already used for another request
voice.retry.notFailed: Only voice messages that failed recognition can be recognized again
voice.plugin.title: Voice
voice.plugin.summary: Hold to talk and send voice messages, transcribed to text; ergo replies and sends messages by voice; manage reference voices in Settings
voice.plugin.purge.recordings: Recordings of the voice messages you sent
voice.plugin.purge.synthesized: Voice messages ergo synthesized (the audio files)
voice.plugin.purge.texts: Text in voice records: what was recognized and what ergo read aloud ("To text" on voice bubbles in chats)
voice.plugin.purge.references: Reference voices (the recordings and transcripts imported in Settings · Voice)
voice.plugin.purge.notices: Notes in the inbox like "Speech recognition unavailable" and "Import a reference voice to get voice replies"
voice.plugin.keep.conversation: What reached ergo as text in conversations (the transcripts ergo saw and its replies): it belongs to the conversation and stays
voice.plugin.keep.materials: Materials transcribed from voice: materials belong to the core — to delete them, use bulk delete in Memory · Materials (Settings · Delete materials when the Memory plugin is gone)
voice.plugin.keep.backup: The copy in backup snapshots (goes away as snapshots rotate: about 7 days locally, up to about 5 weeks in the sync folder)
voice.prompt.flag: True while the voice plugin is running (false when it's disabled or failed to load): wraps the sentences about asking whether to read aloud and reading with the send-voice tool
voice.doctor.speech.title: Speech synthesis
voice.doctor.speech.off: Voice replies aren't on (no speech synthesis installed in Settings · Components, and no service registered on the synthesis port in the service manager), so this isn't checked
voice.doctor.speech.down: Can't reach {url} ({reason}): replies to your voice messages can't be synthesized and fall back to text only
voice.doctor.speech.downState: {reason}: replies to your voice messages can't be synthesized and fall back to text only
voice.doctor.speech.busy: {url} is up, but the GPU is busy with another program: voice replies may fall back to text for now
voice.doctor.speech.failed: {url} is up, but the trial synthesis failed: {reason}
voice.doctor.speech.fixBusy: Run the checkup again in a while; if it stays busy, close the program that's using the GPU
voice.doctor.speech.fixFailed: Fix what the reason above says; if the service itself is at fault, restart {service} in the service manager and check its log
voice.doctor.fixStart: On the computer running ergo, open the service manager, start {service}, then run the checkup again
voice.doctor.fixStartUnknown: Start the service on {url}, then run the checkup again: if it's registered in the service manager, start it there; if you installed it from Components, press Start in Settings · Components
voice.doctor.recognizer.title: Speech recognition
voice.doctor.recognizer.off: Voice input isn't on (no speech recognition installed in Settings · Components and none of your own configured), so this isn't checked
voice.doctor.recognizer.source.spawn: The recognizer process ergo starts itself (faster-whisper)
voice.doctor.recognizer.source.lsm: The recognition service run by the service manager ({url})
voice.doctor.recognizer.broken: {source} can't be used: {reason}. Your voice messages can't be transcribed
voice.doctor.recognizer.down: Can't reach {source} ({reason}): your voice messages can't be transcribed
voice.doctor.recognizer.stale: {source} is reachable, but the last attempt failed: {reason}
voice.doctor.recognizer.fixRetry: Send a voice message to try again (recognition reloads the model first); if it still fails, check the recognition model's status in Settings · Voice
voice.doctor.state.waiting: model not loaded yet; it loads when first needed
voice.doctor.state.unloaded: model unloaded while idle; it loads again with the next voice message
voice.doctor.state.notLoaded: reachable; the model isn't loaded yet and loads with the next voice message (takes tens of seconds)
voice.doctor.references.title: Reference voices
voice.doctor.references.off: Voice replies aren't on, so this isn't checked
voice.doctor.references.none: There are no reference voices: voice replies can't be synthesized and fall back to text only
voice.doctor.references.fix: Import 5–15 seconds of clean speech in Settings · Voice
voice.doctor.ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg
voice.doctor.ffmpeg.missing: ffmpeg isn't on PATH: reference voices can only be imported as WAV, and with audio.cpp recognition, recordings that aren't WAV can't be transcribed
voice.doctor.ffmpeg.fix: Install ffmpeg (for example winget install ffmpeg) so it's on PATH, then restart ergo
voice.doctor.gpu.title: NVIDIA GPU
voice.doctor.gpu.found: NVIDIA GPU present: speech synthesis and recognition run on the GPU
voice.doctor.gpu.none: No NVIDIA GPU: speech synthesis and recognition can only run on the CPU and will be slow
voice.doctor.voiceOff: Neither voice replies nor voice input is on, so this isn't checked
